basic_info.description: 340 Eureka offers a wonderful location, move-in condition, high ceilings, expansion potential and large terraced garden. The handsome grey and cream exterior and front deck set the stage for the lovely main floor. Living room with fireplace and bay window, adjoining dining room and generous library/den with fireplace provide superb social areas. The eat-in kitchen enjoys a gas range, white cabinets, grey counters and deck. Powder room, two bedrooms and full bath complete this floor. Newly carpeted staircase leads to the upper floor large master suite with peaked wood ceiling and cabinetry surrounding a fireplace. The master overlooks an enchanting garden with mature trees and shrubbery, outdoor seating areas and a glimpse of the Bay. A large undeveloped attic space offers the potential to add two bedrooms, another full bath and laundry. On the lower level are the Garage, laundry and two bonus rooms ideal for an exercise, office or game room.
